Beat.description:
`ping` (client) and `pong` (server), doc 09 section 5.5: an optional nonce, which `pong`
echoes, and on `ping` an optional presence state.

oneOf.description: A slot token.
An observe-only spectator link.
A bot's integration credential.
An account (the host console).
A value this version does not know; it grants nothing.

location.description: Location id in the slot's own world.

items.description: The items found; empty for a repeat or an empty location.

Checksum.description: A content hash: `sha256:` and 64 lower-case hex digits.

oneOf.description: First frame of a session.
A command; answered by exactly one `result`.
Read one state path; answered by a `result`.
Follow state paths; answered by a `result` with their values, then `state.changed` events.
Stop following state paths; answered by a `result`.
The game has applied every item up to `applied`.
Heartbeat, sent every `limits.hb_ms` (doc 09 section 5.5); answered by `pong`.
An `op` this version does not know. A server answers it with `op.unknown` (rule 1).

name.description: Free text, length-limited by the server.

oneOf.description: A game or mod.
A browser page.
A console or other device.
A bot with an integration credential.
A tracker.
A spectator view.
The host console.
Synthesized by the compat edge for an existing client.
A kind this version does not know.
The client says it is ready.
The client says it is playing.
A state this version does not know.

data.description: Payload, checked against the type's schema.

CmdId.description: Client-chosen command id (doc 01 D1.10 rule 3): 1 to 64 visible ASCII characters.

CmdResult.description:
The answer to one `cmd`, `get`, `watch` or `unwatch`: `{"cid", "seq"?, "epoch"?, "ok"}` or
`{"cid", "error"}`. Exactly one of `ok` and `error` must be present.

oneOf.description: Done; the value's schema is the command's registered result schema.
Refused.

cid.description: The `cid` of the frame this answers.

upto.description:
The last durable `seq` sent to this session when the result was produced (required);
over HTTP the client applies the result once its stream has reached it (rule 4).

Epoch.description: Owner epoch, the fence token bumped on every room move (doc 02 D5).

approx_lost_seconds.description: Estimated seconds of acknowledged activity lost (doc 06 section 6.4).

recovered_head.description: The last `seq` the new history kept; the client replays its journal after it.

ErrorBody.description: The error shape of doc 01 D1.7.

after_ms.description: Wait this long first, when `retry` is `after`.

key.description:
Registered dotted key; clients localize from it. Kept as a string so a client accepts
keys registered after it was built.

ref.description:
The frame this answers when there is no `cid`: its `op`, or the `cid` of a frame that
could not be decoded.

EventFrame.description: One event (rule 5): durable ones carry `seq`, ephemeral ones `eseq`.

data.description: Payload, shaped by the type's schema.

prev_hash.description: Hash of the previous event, tournament rooms only (D-31).

slot.description: The slot the event is about (rule 6), stamped by the server.

GameId.description: A game id: reverse-domain, lower-case, path-safe (`dev.example.mosscave`). Doc 01 D1.10 rule 8.

world_hash.description: Hash of the world the client holds.

Get.description: Read one state path, or one page of it.

after.description: Page cursor from a previous result's `next`.

limit.description: Page size the client prefers; the server may return fewer.

next.description: Cursor for the next page; absent on the last one.

value.description: Its value, or one page of it.

Hello.description: What the client is and wants, sent once (doc 01 D1.10 rule 9).

client.description: What kind of client this is.

client_time_ms.description: Client wall clock, for skew warnings only.

data_checksum.description: Hash of the name tables the client holds.

game.description: The game the client holds, for game clients.

proto.description: Protocol majors the client speaks, for example `[1]`.

resume.description: Where to resume the room log; absent on a first connect.

takeover.description: Replace an existing session for this seat, after the person confirmed it.

ticket.description: A connect ticket instead of a token (doc 08 section 3.2).

token.description: A credential: slot token or integration credential (doc 01 D1.2). Never in a URL.

ItemFlag.description: Item classification. Unknown flags from newer servers read as `Other`.

oneOf.description: Can unlock logical progress.
Especially useful.
A trap.
A flag this version does not know.

ItemGrant.description: `item.grant` payload; the frame's `slot` is the receiver.

from.description: The finding slot, for location-based sources.

item.description: Item id in the receiver's world.

item_seq.description: The receiver's delivery index, contiguous from 1; what `ack` confirms.

item_uid.description: Stable identity across epochs; clients dedupe by it.

location.description: The location in `from`'s world, for location-based sources.

ItemUid.description:
Stable item identity (doc 01 D1.10 rule 11): `iu_` and 26 Crockford base32 digits (a
128-bit hash).

hb_slack.description: Missed-heartbeat tolerance, as a multiple of `hb_ms`.

max_frame_bytes.description: Largest message the server accepts, in bytes.

LocationChecked.description: `location.checked` payload; the frame's `slot` is the checker.

location.description: Location id in the checker's world.

minor.description: Minor in use; a type whose `since` is above it does not exist on this server.

Replay.description: `welcome.replay`: the durable range, both ends inclusive (rule 4).

to.description: Replay is complete once the event with this `seq` arrived.

epoch.description: Room epoch of that cursor, if known.

epoch_change.description:
For `new_timeline`: the change, so the client can replay its journal after
`recovered_head` (doc 06 section 6.4).

oneOf.description: Replay follows (also for a first connect).
The cursor is older than the retained window: read the inventory in pages.

The room was restored or failed over to another history (doc 01 D5.3 rule 2);
`epoch_change` says where the new history starts.
A status this version does not know; treat it as `new_timeline`.

Retry.description: Retry hint carried by every error frame (doc 01 D1.7).

oneOf.description: Retrying will not help.
Retry with exponential backoff and full jitter (doc 01 D1.7).
Retry after the `after_ms` the server sent.
Retry at once (doc 09 section 4.7, `lobby.stale_ready`).
A hint this version does not know; treat it as `never`.
Owns the room.
Hosts with the owner.
Moderates chat and players.
A value this version does not know; it grants nothing.
Sends checks, receives items.
Reads the player-visible log only.
A value this version does not know; it grants nothing.

Secret.description:
A credential or session id: slot token, integration credential, connect ticket, session.
Its `Debug` and `Display` never print the value, so it cannot leak into logs.

item.description: Item id in the receiver's world.

item_uid.description: The grant's stable identity, as the receiver will see it in `item.grant`.

oneOf.description: Answer to `hello`.
Answer to one `cmd`, `get`, `watch` or `unwatch`.
Something happened in the room.
A problem not tied to a `cid` (rule 13 reasons, a bad frame, a bad `ack`).
Answer to a client `ping`, echoing its nonce.
An `op` this version does not know. Clients ignore it (rule 1).

exts.description: Extensions to have enabled afterwards; an absent id is disabled.

want.description: New wants, replacing the old ones.

SlotGoal.description: `slot.goal` payload (empty); the frame's `slot` reached its goal.

Source.description: Where an item grant came from (rule 11).

oneOf.description: A check of a location.
The finder released its remaining locations.
The receiver collected its remaining items.
A copy for an item link group.
Starting inventory.
Given by a room role.
A source this version does not know; its `from` and `location` are not checked.

StateChanged.description: `state.changed` payload, also one entry of a `watch` result.

prev.description: `kv` paths: the value before the write (`null` when it was unset).

StatePath.description:
A path in the room's state tree (`slot/3/status`, `kv/legacy/Energy%20Link`). Doc 01 D1.10
rule 7. Only the syntax is checked here; [`super::CorePath::parse`] knows which paths exist.

StreamName.description: An optional event stream an enabled extension declares (`lobby`, `lobby.host`, `tracker`).

TypeName.description:
Type of a command or event: a core name (`check`, `item.grant`) or `<extension id>/<name>`
(`org.cwp.deathlink/death`). Doc 01 D1.10 rule 2.

Want.description: Typed wants; replaces bit fields and behaviour-changing tags.

slot_data.description: Include the slot's generator data in `welcome`.

streams.description: Optional event streams declared by enabled extensions.

WantItems.description: Which item grants a session receives. All on by default.

from_others.description: Items found in other slots' worlds.

own.description: Items the slot found in its own world.

Watch.description: Follow or stop following state paths.

WatchOk.description: `watch` result: the current value of each path, atomically.

paths.description: One entry per watched path, in request order.

Welcome.description: The server's answer to `hello` (doc 01 D1.10 rule 9).

exts.description: Enabled extensions; anything absent is off.

head.description: Room-wide `seq` of the last durable event.

names.description: Name-table checksum per game id in the room (rule 8).

replay.description: The durable range about to be replayed; absent when there is nothing to replay.

session.description: Session id; a bearer secret on HTTP transports.

slot.description: The caller's slot, when it has one.

slot_data.description: The slot's generator data, when asked for and small enough.

slot_state.description: Seat readiness block of doc 09 section 4.6.

paths.summary: Seed name, room state, spoiler and race mode, hint settings, release and collect modes, server time.
Every slot: number, name, alias, game id, kind, group members.
Connection, the client's own state claim, goal.
Hints where the slot finds or receives the item.
Name tables; fallback for the HTTP form.

title: CWP v1 (design doc 01 D1.10, proposal D-123). Generated by `cargo test -p proto`; do not edit.

check.summary: Report a checked location in the slot's own world; the result lists the items it held.

goal.summary: The slot reached its goal. Repeats are answered from the first.

item.grant.summary: An item was delivered to the event's slot, with its per-slot item_seq. Sessions of the room.items stream see every grant.

room.epoch_change.summary: The room moved to another history (failover or restore), rule 12.

session.update.summary: Change wants and enable or disable extensions mid-session.

slot.goal.summary: The event's slot reached its goal.

state.changed.summary: A watched state path changed; after a gap in eseq, get it again.

status.set.summary: The client's own state claim (ready, playing); lobby readiness is separate.
